messages:
Anya: Quick sync — need to finalize RICE scores for the throughput/cost initiative. Several customer asks queued and infra dependency. Can we lock this today?
Luke: I added provisional numbers in the sheet: https://notion.redwood.example/priors. My draft: reach=2000/mo, impact=3, confidence=60%, effort=5.
Micah: I think impact should be 4 — customers report 20-30% unit cost wins if we hit the perf targets.
Sophie: Engineering bandwidth is tight. Infra has a month-long kernel queue right now. Realistic effort I’d call 8.
Kevin: Can we sequence it? Do lightweight quantization + batching first (low effort) then kernel optimizations later. That unlocks wins without blocking infra.
Anya: Agree. Propose splitting into two initiatives with separate RICE entries: "Quantization + batching" and "Kernel optimizations (infra)".
Luke: Quick RICE math: R*I*C/E. If we use Micah's impact 4: 2000*4*0.6/8 = 600. Quantization gambit (impact 2, conf 70%, effort 2) -> 2000*2*0.7/2 = 1400. Quantization comes first.
Micah: Caveat: quantization can regress quality on edge prompts. We need eval gating in CI and a rollout criteria before prod.
Sophie: Suggested launch criteria: quality degradation <=2% on core eval set, perf uplift >=10% p95, infra cost down >=15% on sample workloads.
Kevin: Who owns cross-team blockers? Infra needs an owner to reserve a kernel slot. @Micah can you take infra touchpoints?
Micah: I can own infra touchpoints but we need 1 eng FTE for ~6 weeks to handle kernel work and testing.
Anya: We have two discretionary headcount slots in Q2 for product initiatives. I'll escalate to ops; if not approved we shrink kernel scope to just hot-path changes.
Luke: I'll update the RICE sheet with split initiatives and note the dependency. We should also add sequencing in Notion and mark the kernel item as "blocked-by: infra".
Sophie: Done — added label prio:require-infra and pinned the quantization initiative to the top of the three-week queue. I'll reprioritize if the headcount clears.
Kevin: For rollouts, require canary in us-west for 48h + perf smoke tests. Add rollout checklist to PR template.
Micah: I'll add an automated eval job to CI (sampler + golden prompts). If quality drop >1.5% we auto-block the merge.
Anya: Next steps: Luke update RICE with split entries, Sophie reserve sprint slot for quantization work, Micah write infra RFC and FTE estimate, I’ll escalate headcount to ops and update stakeholders.
Luke: Sounds good. I'll also add an estimated time-to-value metric to the sheet to help justify headcount.
Sophie: Ok — tagging the product queue. If ops approves headcount, we flip kernel item to high priority.
Micah: Filed infra RFC and estimate here: https://git.redwood.example/rfcs/infra-kernels (issue #1234).
devops-bot: New issue created by Micah: #1234 infra-rfc-dedicated-kernels (status: open).
Anya: Great. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: We'll reconvene after ops decision or when Luke finishes the RICE update.
